quality_status: Different implementations, not an equal-accuracy comparison; no PPO throughput
provenance_note: Current Newton no-extra-work/history-off adapter. Historical RTX 5880 main table used additional diagnostic and zero joint_f mapping work. All observations below come from this archived run.

installed_newton_source_provenance.scope: Only safe package-relative SolverVBD paths selected; producer-recorded hashes, not re-read from remote installation

device_settings.scope: Archived nvidia-smi configuration snapshot for the UUID used by every timing worker; maximum clocks are specifications, not observed sustained clocks
device_settings.performance_scope: Measured with a 200 W power limit; not the performance at the reported default 450 W limit

hardware_toolchain.cuda_runtime_note: Torch cu128 wheel and CUDA Toolkit 12.6 are separate recorded versions

initialization_definition.cache_note: First scale has a fresh per-run engine cache; later scales reuse it, not a cold-system claim

avbd.control: fixed upstream HOME targets; kp preserved; effort cap according to explicit physics profile; no PPO

newton-avbd.control: fixed upstream HOME targets; kp preserved; effort cap according to explicit physics profile; no PPO
newton-avbd.solver: Newton SolverVBD rigid legacy AVBD, maximal coordinates
newton-avbd.damping_mapping: joint_target_kd=.053, target_qd=0; joint_limit_kd=.053 retains damping when legacy limit takes priority
model_difference_notes: Legacy VBD chooses drive OR limit; native can differ at active limits
Newton friction epsilon .01 m/s and contact manifold differ from native hard static friction
Matched scalar ALM parameters do not prove identical constraint discretization or convergence
newton-avbd.external_generalized_joint_force: None; PD targets and target damping retained
newton-avbd.timed_scope: Every step: clear external forces, CollisionPipeline.collide, SolverVBD.step, state ping-pong
newton-avbd.reset_scope: Both states, solver dual/penalty/history, generalized defaults + FK, forces, pipeline matching, contacts
